chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni informed us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa'id ibn Ghazwan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said:
There will be nine Imams after al-Husayn ibn Ali, their ninth one is their al-Qa'im.
ai.seo_question: Who are the nine Imams following Imam Husayn and who is the final one?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir establishes the foundational count of nine Imams succeeding Imam al-Husayn, a key element in Shia eschatology that identifies the final Imam as al-Qa'im. It underscores the continuity of divine authority (Imamah) through the progeny of Husayn, linking the historical lineage directly to the future resurrection and justice of the Mahdi. This hadith is frequently cited in works like Al-Ghayba to affirm the number and identity of the Twelve Imams.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (25) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob al-Kulayni narrated from Ali bin Ibraheem bin Hashim from his father from ibn Abu Omayr from Sa’eed bin Ghazwan from Abu Baseer that Imam Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:
“Nine imams are after al-Husayn bin Ali. The ninth one is al-Qa’im.”
